frequency_question: How often do central banks implement incremental reserve ratio measures within a comparable short-term horizon when facing excess liquidity?
membership_rule: Includes any official policy action by a major central bank deploying a marginal, incremental, or secondary reserve requirement to absorb specific liquidity surges. Excludes permanent structural changes to baseline reserve requirements.
window: A multi-month operational window comparable to the specified timeframe.
